messages:
sophia: RFC follow-up — precision API contracts & gating for FP8/INT8/4-bit. TL;DR: we need a server-side profile object + clear fallback semantics for safety. Who's got time to align on data/telemetry requirements?

 dmitri: +1. main questions: (1) profile schema (2) default behavior for older SDKs (3) rollouts + auto-fallback triggers

 kai: For schema propose minimal fields: name, bits, per_layer_overrides (hash), fallback_order, calibration_blob_id, quality_thresholds. Also keep `stable` flag.

 anna: sample sketch of profile (paste JSON):
```json
{
  "name": "fp8-fast-1",
  "bits": "fp8",
  "fallback_order": ["int8","fp16"],
  "calibration_blob": "cal/2026-10-03/sha256:abcd1234",
  "quality_threshold": "delta_rouge<=0.03"
}
```

 marcus: don't hardcode metric names in profiles. Use telemetry keys + comparator: e.g. `metrics:[{"key":"exact_match","op":">=","threshold":0.95}]`

 eli: compatibility: if SDK doesn't send `precision_profile`, server should pick customer-default or `auto` which uses perf/quality policy. Important for existing users.

 eng-bot: deploy note: feature-flag `quant_profiles_v2` enabled in staging

 sophia: rollout plan: (a) implement server-side profile store + API to attach profile to model route (b) console UI to preview expected cost/latency deltas (c) canary at 1% with golden prompt set monitoring (d) auto-disable profile if quality drop > configured threshold

 dmitri: auto-fallback trigger suggestions: latency SLO breach? maybe no — fallback for QUALITY only. Latency/cost changes should be alerts but not auto-fallback.

 anna: We need calibration blob lifecycle: small blobs (<=5MB) stored in S3 + retention 90 days. Add calibration_hash to profile to ensure determinism.

 kai: eviction policy for local cache on GPU nodes: LRU + pinned blobs for Dedicated tenants. Also must version kernels with profile hash to avoid silent mismatches.

 marcus: tests: add eval harness integration: nightly against shortlisted prompt sets + adversarial sets. If regression found mark profile `quarantine` flag.

 eli: API proposal: REST param `precision_profile` string ID; SDK exposes `client.call(..., precision_profile='name')` fallback to `None`.

 ops-bot: noted — we'll add Kubernetes rollout job to ramp flag in 0.5% increments with health checks.

 sophia: ok action items: anna schema PR, dmitri rollout doc, kai runtime cache patch, marcus eval harness test cases. Ping me @sophia when PRs landed. :thumbsup:
